name: HP LaserJet 1018 / 1020 / P1005 / P1006 / P1505 (host-based)
summary: Host-based laser printers: they have no page language of their own (command set ACL/ZjStream) and need their firmware sent from the computer every time they power on. Generic drivers cannot drive them.

steps.title: Download HP's firmware plugin
steps.explain: Open a terminal and run:  hp-plugin -i   then accept HP's license. This downloads the firmware these printers need at power-on. Unplug and replug the printer afterwards.

linux.notes: HPLIP's hpcups driver supports these models once the proprietary plugin (firmware) is installed. The open-source foo2zjs driver is an alternative.

darwin.notes: HP did not publish drivers for these models for current macOS. There is no ready-made recipe here yet: ask the assistant to research options for your macOS version, and please share what works so the next person gets it in one click.

win32.notes: Windows Update usually provides a driver for these models. If Device Manager shows Code 28, use "Ask Windows to look for a driver".
